name: Anatomy Ace
label: ANATOMY CHECK

deepdive.note: One Anatomy Deep Dive a day at 18:00 from Nov 7, 2026 (Yashas approved Nov 6). The 18:00 slot posts a quiz when no new deep dive is ready. Nov 10, 2026 (share plan, approved by Yashas): share-first videos go first (One Take, future parents, everyday warnings, then the most sendable of the rest); textbook processes (membrane transport, transcription, translation) last. Nov 14, 2026 (Yashas): a second deep dive at 20:00 replaces that quiz (deep dives: 1,258 median views and 0.91% shares per reach vs quizzes' 361 and 0.21%); with none ready it posts a quiz. Nov 15, 2026 (Yashas): 20:00 goes back to an automatic quiz from Nov 17 (Monday's queued One Take stays).

formats.note: Two of the five daily quizzes rotate through five short formats (Yashas, Nov 6, 2026): Which bone is missing?, Zoom out, Diagnose this, Myth or fact, Rank these. Each day takes the next two in the cycle; a format with nothing ready passes to the next, and with nothing ready at all the slot posts a quiz. Keep it until the Strategist has data on which formats win. Nov 9, 2026: a sixth format, "types" (Types of fracture: one femur broken 11 ways in a gray studio, anatomy/types.py), copied from a breakdown reel Yashas liked; with six formats each comes round every three days. Nov 14, 2026 (Yashas): Zoom out, Rank these and Myth or fact are dropped (0 shares in 7 posts, 184-288 median views at 1 day); the cycle is Types, Diagnose this, Which bone is missing. Nov 21, 2026 (Yashas): Which bone is missing? is dropped (weak results); the cycle is Types and Diagnose this.

rotation_note: Nov 6, 2026: on Instagram, bone and muscle quizzes about famous, feel-it-yourself parts got 750-1,400 views at 1 day (10 of 15 since Nov 1); organ quizzes (heart, lungs, abdomen, eye, teeth) got 128-417 (0 of 6). So the two daily 3D quizzes use bone and muscle regions only. The organ banks stay for later (deep dives cover organs).
ramp_note: Only the 09:30 and 20:00 slots use quiz stock now (the others are deep dives and formats), so 14 unused questions (a week) is enough for all 5 slots.

notify.note: Add a trending sound from Instagram's Trending list. Keep the original audio (the voice) up and the song low, then post.
notify.why: Trending-sound test (Yashas, Nov 6, 2026): Ball Knowledge's hand-finished posts with a trending sound got about 1,000 Instagram views vs 155 for automatic ones (3 vs 10 posts). The 8 PM quiz's Instagram post goes out as Buffer 'Notify me'; TikTok and YouTube stay automatic. Ended Nov 23, 2026 (Yashas): the 8 PM Instagram post goes out automatically again.

first_comment.note: Yashas, Nov 21, 2026: first comments on. Quizzes get their hint (hints.json); Types videos get their own first_comment or this line; a video's json can set first_comment (the follower series asks for the next topic). Nov 24, 2026: OFF. Buffer's free plan refuses any post with a first comment ('First comment requires a paid plan'), so those Instagram posts were never queued.
first_comment.diagnose: What's your diagnosis? Comment before you check the answer 👇
first_comment.quiz: A, B, C or D? Comment your answer 👇
first_comment.deepdive: Did you know this? Tell us what surprised you 👇

hits_note: Hit check (anatomy/hits.py, daily after the tracker): an Instagram post 12-72 h old with 3x the median views (and 1,000+) or 3x the median shares per reach (and 2+ shares) of the last 30 Instagram posts of its own type makes its series hot for 5 days; a type with under 6 posts is compared with all Instagram posts at 2x. Deep dive series come from series.json. Hot series post first in their slots; hits.json keeps the record.

quiz_look.note: Quiz look A/B test (Yashas, Nov 15, 2026): the 09:30 quiz renders in the studio look (the gray sweep and realistic bone of the Types videos, anatomy/make.py look="studio") on odd days counted from "from" (Nov 17, 19, 21...) and in the classic black card on the others. History records "look"; the scorecard's "Quiz look A/B" table compares them. Posts before "from" render exactly as before.

20:00.note: Yashas, Nov 15: the 20:00 quiz uses the background track of our most viral post (11 types of fracture, ambient-2).

ask_the_ace.note: The follower series (fmt-types-15 on). An episode item only sets "ask": {"episode", "handle", "request"}; anatomy/types.py fills in the rest from here: the title card and badge at frame 0, the sting, the spoken opener, the sign-off, the credit card and the caption lines.
ask_the_ace.title: ASK THE ACE
ask_the_ace.opener: Ask the Ace, [#{n}](nˈʌmbɚ {n_ph}). You pick it, we dissect it.
signoff: Comment your topic. The top comment picks [#{next}](nˈʌmbɚ {next_ph}).
Follow to see if yours gets picked.
ask_the_ace.caption_first: ASK THE ACE #{n}: you pick it, we dissect it 🦴
ask_the_ace.caption_extra: Top comment picks the next video in the series 👇
